players.product: Xiyun C500/C600 training-inference GPGPU boards and modules (plus Xisi N inference GPUs), GPU servers and supernode/cluster solutions with the MXMACA software stack

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: the Xiyun C600 (the company's first GPU on an all-domestic process) reached risk production at the end of 2025, and the company expects it to reach volume-production sales in H1 2026; it says the C600 is expected to become its next-generation main product.
